name: Yokkyuu Fuman na Aniyome no Yuuwaku ~Ore no Shiru Aniyome wa, Yasashii Teishuku Tsuma Datta no ni!?~
original_name: 欲求不満な兄嫁の誘惑 ～俺の知る兄嫁は、優しい貞淑妻だったのに!?～
source:
In order to attend my college, I stayed at my brother and his wife's house. One day, my brother had to go abroad for a few months. 

So, I started living together with my sister-in-law, Uenohara Ringo-san.

"......Rikuto, -kun."

A quiet house with almost no noise. In a room where I couldn't even hear the sound of the television, I thought I heard Ringo-san's voice. From somewhere, I felt like my name was being called.

"Probably just my imagination?"

I tried to listen closely, but I didn't hear any voice. If Ringo-san did need something from me, she'd have call me again. It was too early for dinnertime, there was no reason for me to be called at that moment. Perhaps she was doing housework, and somehow uttered a sound that was similar to my name. If she were to scream, then I'd have to check it out though.

At that moment, in order to calm her burning body, Ringo is masturbating alone. She imagines doing it with her husband, but eventually, her imagination becomes "Rikuto......."

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1274300]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
为了上大学，我住在我哥哥和他妻子的家里。有一天，我弟弟不得不出国几个月。

于是，我开始和嫂子上野原林檎桑一起生活。

“……陆人君。”

安静的房子，几乎听不到任何噪音。在连电视声音都听不到的房间里，我好像听到了林檎桑的声音。我感觉有人在叫我的名字。

“或许只是我的想象？”

我试图仔细听，但没有听到任何声音。如果林檎桑确实需要我帮忙的话，她会再打电话给我的。距离晚餐时间还太早，没有理由在那个时候叫我。也许她正在做家务，不知为何发出了和我名字相似的声音。如果她尖叫的话，我就得去看看。

此刻，为了让火热的身体平静下来，林檎独自自慰。她想象着和丈夫一起做这件事，但最终，她的想象变成了“陆人……”

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1274300]Getchu[/url]]
